The Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering encourages active involvement of faculty and students in collaborative programmes, both at the national and international level. Faculties are involved in research and project work, development of academic programmes, training of students and teaching materials.

These programmes range from exchange of students and faculty in terms of research and project work, development of academic programmes and training of students, exchange of publications, data, teaching materials, ensuring optimum utilization of infrastructure facilities.

  Research Laboratory

The Research Centre at the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering has been recognized by Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belgavi. This facility promotes fostering innovation in the field of Electrical and Electronics Engineering.

The center focuses on cutting-edge research across various specialized domains, including Power Systems Engineering, High Voltage Engineering, Power Electronics, and other emerging areas of Electrical Engineering

The Research Laboratory has the following facilities:
  • Mi-Power, Powerworld Simulator, integrated development environment (IDE) software application that provides comprehensive facilities to computer Programmers for software development. Computing Systems ,Updated Software’s
  • Reputed Journal access like IEEE, Science Direct, Springer E-books & E-Journals and Other reputed open Access Journals to the Research Scholars.
  • Sufficient research related books and Internet facility.

Product Development

The Department is dedicated to enhancing the learning experience through the creation of innovative products, Instructional Material, Research Lab facility and Working Models/Charts/Monograms. These resources are designed to provide students with hands-on exposure to theoretical concepts, bridging the gap between classroom learning and practical application.

The Instructional Material, includes Course Material/Handout, Lab Videos etc,  which supports teaching and learning process. Working Models, Charts, and Monograms visually demonstrate key principles, helping to simplify and reinforce learning. Research Lab offers facility to Scholars to pursue their Research Work and produce Research articles.

The Department has self-produced Laboratory kits for conducting experiments. The validation of the Kit performance is verified by Technical committee.

  Innovation-Product transformed to Patent Title: IoT based Wearable Device And System ffor Assisting Neurologically Affected Patients

A patent has been granted for the invention titled "IOT-Based Wearable Device and System for Assisting Neurologically Affected Patients", as per the application number 202241007932. The patent was filed on 15th February 2022 by ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru. This innovative device aims to assist patients affected by neurological disorders by leveraging Internet of Things (IoT) technology for monitoring and aiding in their medical needs.

The patent is granted for a term of 20 years from the filing date, in accordance with the Patents Act, 1970. This development marks a significant step in medical technology, particularly in improving the lives of patients with neurological conditions through advanced wearable solutions.

  Innovation-Product leading to IPR

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering is filing multiple innovations for patents, showcasing advancements in healthcare, agriculture, and energy solutions. These include projects like the Ergonomic Tremor Control Spoon, IoT-Based Ration Vending Machine, and Smart Agriculture Farming Using Aeroponics. These patents reflect the department's commitment to fostering innovation and addressing real-world challenges. Title: Portable Baby Incubator with Sleep Apnea Monitoring for Premature Infants Purpose

The project aims to design a portable and affordable incubator for premature infants, addressing the need in rural hospitals and government maternity centers. It maintains suitable temperature and humidity for neonates and integrates a sleep apnea monitoring system to track heart rate and SpO2 during sleep. This incubator is a cost-effective alternative to expensive models, tested across various age groups with satisfactory results. It addresses both premature birth and sleep apnea, offering a reliable solution during emergencies, disease outbreaks, or natural calamities in resource-limited areas.

  Title of the work: DEVELOPMENT OF SYNCHRONOUS MOTOR FOR WATER PUMPING Purpose of the Work

The primary goal of this project is to develop an efficient and high-performance synchronous motor-based water pumping system to replace conventional induction motor-driven pumps. The project aims to address the key limitations of induction motors, such as high starting current, low power factor, and excessive power losses, by leveraging the advantages of synchronous motors, including higher efficiency, reduced I²R losses, and improved power factor.

By designing the synchronous motor's stator in a manner similar to an induction motor (delta-run configuration), the proposed system ensures a seamless transition while maintaining the reliability and operational simplicity of existing pump setups. This development is particularly crucial for applications requiring continuous and energy-efficient water supply.

The ultimate objective is to convert this research into a viable product by designing a commercially adaptable synchronous motor-driven water pump that can be implemented in domestic, industrial, and agricultural applications. This innovation will help reduce energy consumption, lower operational costs, and enhance overall system performance, contributing to sustainable and cost-effective water management solutions.
